title: A Echo for the Static
premise: Ansel Marchetti smuggles memories in his skull past the quarantine that has sealed the colony world of Vesper from the rest of the network for twelve years. When the colony's children begin dreaming the same dream — a message encoded by a dying engineer who hid the truth of who started the war inside their sleep — Ansel realizes the contraband he's been carrying is the evidence both governments will kill to bury or to own. Hunted by customs officers, corporate agents, and the found family of smugglers he's beginning to trust, Ansel must choose between delivering the truth and protecting the people who've become his home. In the end he broadcasts the memory openly, ending the war but burning every bridge back to his old life, and chooses to stay on Vesper as its first free courier.
about_author: Ivo Brightwater is the pen name of a former radio technician who spent a decade repairing transmitters in remote northern communities before turning to fiction. Their work explores how people build families out of static, distance, and stubborn loyalty.

chapters.title: The Long Quiet
chapters.summary: Ansel's POV. He runs a memory shipment through orbital customs at Vesper, nearly caught by Inspector Rhee, and delivers to his fence, Odile, who runs a noodle bar that fronts for the smuggler network. The beat establishes his loneliness and the rules of his trade: carry, don't look.

chapters.title: Children of the Same Sleep
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Her daughter Mira wakes screaming with a dream identical to forty other children's: a burning relay station and a voice repeating coordinates. The colony doctor calls it mass hysteria; Odile recognizes the voice as her dead brother's. Beat: dread entering the domestic sphere.

chapters.title: Contraband That Breathes
chapters.summary: Ansel's POV. Examining his latest cargo, he finds an unlabeled memory chip humming with the same dream-pattern, and realizes he's been carrying it for months without knowing. When he plays a fragment, he sees the war's opening shot from the wrong side. Beat: the carrier becomes complicit.

chapters.title: Rhee Comes Calling
chapters.summary: Inspector Rhee's POV. She isn't customs anymore — she's been seconded to a corporate task force hunting the dream. She offers Ansel immunity to inform on Odile's network, revealing the children are being quietly disappeared. Beat: temptation wrapped in reasonableness.

chapters.title: The Noodle Bar Burns
chapters.summary: Ansel's POV. Task force raiders torch Odile's bar; Ansel pulls Mira and two other dreaming children out through the smugglers' tunnels while Odile covers them and is taken. For the first time, Ansel fights for someone instead of fleeing alone. Beat: found family forged in fire.

chapters.title: What the Engineer Knew
chapters.summary: Mira's POV. Guided by the dream, the fugitives reach the ruined relay station where engineer Tomas Vey recorded the truth before dying: both governments fired first, on orders from the same arms consortium. The children aren't haunted — they're couriers. Beat: grief transmuted into purpose.

chapters.title: Loyalty Priced in Blood
chapters.summary: Odile's POV, captive. Interrogated by the consortium's agent, she gives up nothing but learns Ansel is alive and carrying the full memory. She escapes by trading her captor's own blackmail archive against him. Beat: loyalty as resistance; the cost made explicit.

chapters.title: Every Frequency at Once
chapters.summary: Ansel's POV. Cornered at the old broadcast array with Rhee holding a weapon and the truth in his head, he makes his case to her — her own sister was conscripted into the cover-up. Rhee lowers her gun and hands him the uplink key. Beat: the climax pivot, an enemy choosing truth.

chapters.title: A Echo for the Static
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs interwoven. Ansel broadcasts the engineer's memory across every channel, unencrypted, to both worlds at once. Riets of revelation ripple through fleets and colonies; the war machine stalls mid-strike as soldiers recognize their own orders in the record. Beat: catharsis and terror at once.

chapters.title: The First Free Courier
chapters.summary: Ansel's POV, months later. The consortium stands exposed, borders reopening, and Odile — freed — rebuilds the noodle bar with Mira behind the counter. Offered amnesty and a clean route off-world, Ansel instead signs on as Vesper's independent courier. Beat: quiet resolution; family chosen over escape.
